card.name: Volume units mL and L after a number
card.fires_on: The volume unit mL (or L) right after a number, usually before a slash such as /kg, /min or /hour, or before "of" a solution.

modes.label: Rate per time
modes.description: mL or L after a number in an infusion or flow rate, followed by /min, /hour or /m2.
modes.example: at a rate of 50<< mL>>/hour to 100

modes.label: Volume per body weight
modes.description: mL after a number in a per-kilogram amount.

modes.label: Plain volume of solution
modes.description: mL after a number giving an amount of a named solution.

card.plain: It marks the unit mL or L written right after a number in a volume or flow-rate statement.
